question_cn: 2026 世界杯 F 组小组赛：荷兰 vs 瑞典（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Netherlands vs Sweden (three-way 90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 荷兰Elo全面占优、约六成胜率，但蒂姆贝尔与西蒙斯伤缺叠加瑞典双前锋火力，冷门窗口并未完全关闭。
one_liner_en: The Netherlands hold a clear Elo edge and roughly a 60% win probability, but the Timber and Simons absences plus Sweden's strike pair keep the upset window ajar.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距236分：荷兰1948（第8）对瑞典1712（第43），统计模型给出约62%的荷兰基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 236-point Elo gap — Netherlands 1948 (8th) vs Sweden 1712 (43rd) — yields a ~62% baseline Dutch win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰减员明显：蒂姆贝尔因腹股沟伤退出世界杯、西蒙斯ACL报销，首发结构受损。
key_reasons.en: Dutch absences bite: Timber withdrawn with a groin injury and Simons out with an ACL rupture, weakening the starting XI.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞典锋线高于其排名水平：居克雷什英超21球并附加赛绝杀波兰，但伊萨克长期伤后体能存疑。
key_reasons.en: Sweden's forwards outclass their ranking: Gyokeres scored 21 PL goals and the play-off winner vs Poland, though Isak's fitness remains in doubt.

method_note: Davidson three-way Elo (scale=400, drawNu=0.7) on eloratings.net 2026-06-11 snapshot; neutral venue, no host bonus; evidence-bounded adjustment of -3.0pp Netherlands redistributed to draw/Sweden (cap +/-8pp). Market-blind: no odds or prediction-market data used.
